name: SBI Leasing Services Co., Ltd.
summary: SBI Leasing Services Co., Ltd. engages in the arrangement and selling of investment funds in the operating lease business primarily focused on aircraft and ships. It operates through three segments: Fund Business, General Aviation Business, and Principal Investment Business. It engages in financial services, investment, asset management, crypto-assets, and next gen business.
